credits.title: Roma elastica
credits.overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

credits.title: Don't Let the Sun
credits.overview: In a world almost like ours, Jonah works for an agency that offers human relationships. When he's hired to serve as Nika's father, he begins to lose control of his tightly controlled life.

credits.title: Tutta colpa del rock
credits.overview: After falling from grace and ending up in prison, a failed rock guitarist forms a band with other inmates to win a contest and fulfill his daughter's dream.

credits.title: Animali randagi
credits.overview: Drivers Luca and Toni are driving an ambulance to Serbia to repatriate Emir, a sick man searching for his past. Travelling with them is Maria, his daughter, who hasn’t seen him for years. The journey eastwards lays bare the secrets of four lives, propelling them towards a decisive turning point.

credits.title: Another Summer Holiday
credits.overview: Altiero Molino is a twenty-six-year-old digital entrepreneur who’s returning to Ventotene with his model husband in order to gather his old friends together around his ailing father so as to treat him to one last holiday in this place which is so special to him. He didn’t expect to find the island all abuzz with Sabry

credits.title: Romantiche
credits.overview: A portrait of the flaws and peculiarities of four type of girls living in different districts of Rome.

credits.title: The Desired War
credits.overview: A diplomatic incident threatens to break out a war inside Europe that only an unlikely couple of bickering lovers seems able to stop.

credits.title: My Soul Summer
credits.overview: A shy 17-year-old girl playing classical piano discovers soul music through a strange friendship with an old rocker in a summer that will change her life.

credits.title: The Castle of the Tarots
credits.overview: A short by Matteo Garrone to present the Dior Spring Summer 2021 Haute Couture Collection.

credits.title: Blue Kids
credits.overview: A brother and a sister live on the borderline between awareness of their actions and total unconsciousness, until they commit a sin from which there is no return.

credits.title: Me, Them and Lara
credits.overview: A priest, after spending years in humanitary missions in Africa, reunites with his family, which is in worse conditions than when he left, and above all meets a young lady who will make him doubt both himself and his faith.

credits.title: August Vacation
credits.overview: Like every August, journalist Sandro, his family and acquaintances vacation on the island of Ventotene. This time, however, they find out the house next door has been rented to a lower middle class family, whose crass nature and values soon clash with their own intellectual and progressive background.
